cohortSupport: Only 7 accepted observations from the two previously frozen batches. Exclude exploratory visits and use all eligible reserved visits. Estimate with the first-batch UVIS2 median and test on the reserves of each chip. As a secondary sensitivity test, fit the two reserved UVIS1 visits and evaluate on the three reserved UVIS2 visits.
scope: Compare zero correction and the trained correction within each evaluation set. Report errors in differences of colors from radii 5 and 10 and the training min-max envelope as a descriptive diagnostic. The chip is associated with visits, times and detector positions, so these are transfer errors, not estimates of the causal chip effect.
